command: cd /workspace/pr/head; echo "--- pipeline-run.sh"; grep -n 'u0000\|^run_phase()\|^gate_verdict()\|codex 0\.137\|^plan_phases()\|^}' evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh | grep -n '' | sed -n '1,40p' | grep -v '^[0-9]*:[0-9]*:}$' ; awk '/^run_phase\(\)/{s=NR} s && /^}/ && NR>s {print "run_phase spans " s "-" NR; exit}' evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh; echo "--- sandbox-mount.sh"; grep -n 'cp -a "\$tree/.claude/."\|files, never a symlink\|tools/gen-checksums.sh" how\|"\$tool" --root\|never .claude/ code\|Hashing is Python' evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh; echo "--- check-loa.sh"; grep -n 'elif \[\[ "\$submodule_mount"\|not_mounted=\$((\|return 0' .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh | head -5; echo "--- bats-tests.yml"; grep -n 'Integrity manifest gate\|gen-checksums.sh --check\|check-manifest-paths.sh\|Run eval harness tests\|bats --print-output-on-failure evals' .github/workflows/bats-tests.yml; echo "--- took-effect.sh dup"; grep -n '^expected_labels()\|^rule_integrity_clean' evals/harness/took-effect.sh; echo "--- ablation-row.sh"; grep -n '^ROW="\|^envelope()\|^MINV=\|PIPE_JSON="\$(jq' evals/harness/ablation-row.sh; echo "--- Dockerfile"; grep -n 'FROM rust\|cargo install\|No beads' evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation; echo "--- fingerprint"; grep -n 'diff-so-fancy' evals/harness/fingerprint.sh; echo "--- tests"; grep -n 'cp -a "\$FX/runs"' evals/tests/took-effect.bats evals/tests/ablation-row.bats; grep -n 'MP-6' tests/unit/check-manifest-paths.bats; grep -n 'GC-8' tests/unit/gen-checksums.bats; echo "--- model-config entry"; grep -n 'gpt-6.1-sol:' .claude/defaults/model-config.yaml; grep -n 'cli_model: gpt-6.1-sol' .claude/defaults/model-config.yaml

cd /workspace/pr/head; echo "== EVAL_PROMPT_TREE refs"; grep -rn "EVAL_PROMPT_TREE" evals/harness/*.sh evals/harness/lib/*.sh | head; echo "== execute-agent regen context"; sed -n 150,235p evals/harness/execute-agent.sh; echo "== execute-agent git init?"; grep -n "git init\|git -C\|ls-files" evals/harness/execute-agent.sh | head

cd /workspace/pr/head; echo "== dangerous patterns in harness"; grep -nE '(^|[^a-z_])(eval|source|\. ) |bash "\$|sh -c|curl |wget |chmod 777|--privileged|docker run' evals/harness/*.sh evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh tools/*.sh | grep -v '^\s*#' | grep -vE ':\s*#' | head -40; echo "== run-arms diff summary"; awk '/^diff --git a\/evals\/harness\/run-arms.sh/,/^diff --git a\/evals\/harness\/spend.sh/' ../head.diff | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^[-+]{3}' | grep -vE '^[-+]\s*#' | head -120

cd /workspace/pr/head; cat -n evals/harness/fingerprint.sh | sed -n 34,96p; echo "== freeze exec-ish"; grep -nE 'cp |mv |rm |sha256|tar |git ' evals/harness/freeze.sh | head -20; echo "== validate-suite exec-ish"; grep -nE 'yq |jq -|bash |python3' evals/harness/validate-suite.sh | head -15; echo "== spend.sh exec-ish"; grep -nE 'yq |bash |python3|flock|\$\(' evals/harness/spend.sh | head -20
